Title: Successfully add multiple holidays for a shop in a single request
Preconditions: User is logged in as a SHOP_OWNER with an existing shop (ID: 100). The shop has no existing holidays on the dates being added.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the 'Shop Holidays' section in the shop management dashboard. 2. Click the 'Add Holidays' button. 3. In the 'Add Holidays' form, enter the following dates and reasons: - 2024-12-25: Christmas Day - 2024-12-26: Boxing Day 4. Click the 'Save' button.

Test Data: Dates: 2024-12-25, 2024-12-26; Reasons: Christmas Day, Boxing Day
Expected Result: A success message 'All holidays added successfully for shop [shop name]' is displayed. The holiday list refreshes and shows both holidays with their respective dates and reasons.

Title: Fail to add duplicate holidays for the same shop and dates in a single request
Preconditions: User is logged in as a SHOP_OWNER with an existing shop (ID: 100). The shop already has a holiday on 2024-12-25 (Christmas Day).
Steps:
1. Navigate to the 'Shop Holidays' section in the shop management dashboard. 2. Click the 'Add Holidays' button. 3. In the 'Add Holidays' form, enter the following dates and reasons: - 2024-12-25: Christmas Holiday - 2024-12-26: Boxing Day 4. Click the 'Save' button.

Test Data: Dates: 2024-12-25, 2024-12-26; Reasons: Christmas Holiday, Boxing Day
Expected Result: A success message 'Some holidays were already declared and were skipped: [2024-12-25]' is displayed. The holiday list refreshes and shows the new holiday for 2024-12-26 only.

Title: Successfully configure a new slot for a shop and verify it appears in the slot list
Preconditions: User is logged in as a SHOP_OWNER with an existing shop (ID: 100). The shop has no existing EVENING slot configured.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the 'Slot Configuration' section in the shop management dashboard. 2. Click the 'Add Slot' button. 3. In the 'Add Slot' form, select 'EVENING' as the slot type, set start time to '17:00', and end time to '20:00'. 4. Click the 'Save' button.

Test Data: Slot Type: EVENING; Start Time: 17:00; End Time: 20:00
Expected Result: A success message 'Slot configuration saved for EVENING period.' is displayed. The slot list refreshes and shows the new EVENING slot with start time '17:00', end time '20:00', and status 'Active'.

Title: Fail to configure a new slot for a shop due to duplicate slot type
Preconditions: User is logged in as a SHOP_OWNER with an existing shop (ID: 100). The shop already has a MORNING slot configured.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the 'Slot Configuration' section in the shop management dashboard. 2. Click the 'Add Slot' button. 3. In the 'Add Slot' form, select 'MORNING' as the slot type, set start time to '09:00', and end time to '12:00'. 4. Click the 'Save' button.

Test Data: Slot Type: MORNING; Start Time: 09:00; End Time: 12:00
Expected Result: An error message 'Error: A slot with type MORNING already exists for this shop.' is displayed. No new slot is added to the slot list for the shop.

Title: Fail to update an existing shop holiday to a date that already has a holiday for the same shop
Preconditions: User is logged in as a SHOP_OWNER with an existing shop (ID: 100). The shop has holidays on 2024-12-25 (Christmas Day) and 2024-12-31 (New Year's Eve).
Steps:
1. Navigate to the 'Shop Holidays' section in the shop management dashboard. 2. Locate the holiday for 2024-12-25 and click the 'Edit' button. 3. In the 'Edit Holiday' form, change the date to '2024-12-31' and keep the reason as 'Christmas Day'. 4. Click the 'Save' button.

Test Data: New Date: 2024-12-31; Reason: Christmas Day
Expected Result: An error message 'Shop already has a holiday on 2024-12-31' is displayed. The holiday date remains unchanged (2024-12-25) in the list.
